cards.title: Long-range hopping on a half-filled ring

source_refs.value: Main Eq. (2) and paragraph below it

checks.reason: Main Eq. (2) prints the hopping amplitude and the text specifies a ring, half filling, and a Neel initial state.
The minimum periodic distance makes the finite ring translationally invariant and recovers nearest-neighbor hopping as p tends to infinity.
The constructed matrix is Hermitian, circulant, has zero diagonal, and conserves particle number.

cards.numerical_form: Build the circulant hopping matrix from the minimum periodic distance and propagate occupied orbitals with its exact spectral exponential.
open_questions: The finite-ring distance convention is not explicitly printed; minimum periodic distance is declared rather than inferred from pixels.

cards.title: Normalized quantum-state-diffusion equation

checks.reason: The paper prints M_s=n_s-<n_s> and noise covariance gamma dt.
Expanding the diagonal one-body exponential exp[xi_s-gamma(1-<n_s>)dt] through Ito order reproduces the non-scalar terms of the printed normalized SSE.
QR after every measurement step preserves an orthonormal occupied subspace and exactly fixed particle number.
At gamma=0 the split step reduces to exact unitary evolution; at zero hopping monitoring preserves number-basis Slater determinants.

cards.numerical_form: Use a symmetric unitary/measurement split; draw xi_s~N(0,gamma dt), apply the derived diagonal exponential, and QR the occupied orbitals.
open_questions: The paper omits dt, burn-in, stationary-time tolerance, and trajectory count; these are convergence parameters.

cards.title: Gaussian entropy and positive correlation observables

checks.reason: Main Eq. (4) defines subsystem von Neumann entropy and plots a positive modulus-squared one-body correlator.
For a number-conserving Gaussian state the eigenvalues of the restricted projector give the exact subsystem entropy.
A number-basis product state has projector eigenvalues zero or one and therefore zero entanglement.
Translation averaging is performed only after evaluating each trajectory's nonlinear observable.

cards.numerical_form: Construct G=QQ^dagger, diagonalize each contiguous subsystem block for S, and average |G_xy|^2 over origins and trajectories.

cards.title: Wick sign of the connected density covariance

checks.reason: Main Eq. (4b) explicitly equates the connected density covariance with positive |G_xy|^2.
Direct fermionic Wick contraction gives -|G_xy|^2 for distinct sites.
Independent exact-Fock and Slater-projector checks are required to compare the literal covariance with the plotted positive quantity.

cards.numerical_form: Store both the literal signed covariance and C_+=|G_xy|^2; reproduce the positive plotted magnitude while preserving the sign discrepancy for review.
open_questions: Did the authors intend C to mean minus the connected covariance?

cards.title: Finite-size scaling and fit observables

checks.reason: The supplement prints the CFT chord-length form, the half-chain mixed ansatz, and the L/4 to 3L/4 fit window.
B=0 gives CFT or area-law entropy scaling; b>0 and a<2 identify the algebraic phase.
Synthetic curves with known c, a, and b are recovered by the independent fitting functions.

cards.numerical_form: Fit central charge on the printed chord-length window and extract power-law exponents from size/subsystem data with uncertainty and finite-size diagnostics.
open_questions: The paper does not print fit weights or uncertainty model.

cards.title: Replica long-range term and exponent doubling

checks.reason: The supplement derives the first nonzero relative-replica contribution at second order in the microscopic hopping.
Multiplying the two hopping kernels gives |y|^-2p and the Keldysh identification supplies the imaginary coefficient.
Two space integrals and one time integral give the canonical coupling dimension 3-2p.

cards.numerical_form: Evaluate the independent continuum kernel and RG scaling dimension without importing trajectory data.

cards.title: Infrared long-range kernel and threshold

checks.reason: The supplement prints the rescaling integral and separates p below and above 3/2.
For 1<p<3/2 the nonanalytic exponent 2p-1 is below two and dominates q^2; above 3/2 the ultraviolet contribution restores q^2.
Log-log quadrature over independently chosen q values must recover 2p-1 below the threshold and two above it.

cards.numerical_form: Numerically integrate K_p(q), fit its infrared exponent, and verify the crossover at p=3/2.

cards.title: Dark-state covariance and algebraic exponents

checks.reason: The main text and supplement print the covariance and both real-space exponents.
One-dimensional Fourier scaling maps |q|^(p-5/2) to l^(3/2-p), and two derivatives give a=p+1/2.
At p approaching 3/2 from below, b tends to zero and a tends to two; b=2-a identically.

cards.numerical_form: Generate the analytic theory lines and independently fit discrete Fourier/quadrature data for the same exponents.

cards.title: First-order long-range RG flow

checks.reason: Both flow equations are printed in the main text and derived in the supplement.
At small eta, the sign of 3-2p makes Delta grow below p=3/2 and decay above it.
Independent ODE integration reproduces the opposing flow directions on the two sides of p=3/2.

cards.numerical_form: Integrate the complex or real-proxy RG flow as an independent phase-classification diagnostic.
open_questions: The paper rescales an approximately constant F_a into Delta, so RG amplitudes are convention-dependent while flow directions are robust.
